question: Which materials are enumerated as suitable for the vessels addressed to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are mentioned
Vessels of tortoise origin are mentioned
Vessels of bell metal and copper are mentioned
inference: Clay, tortoise-derived, bell-metal, and copper vessels are enumerated as suitable
uncertainties: The exact nature of kūrmajaṃ as a vessel material is uncertain
plain_english: O Goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell metal, or made of copper.
